show.description:
A powerful CEO hides her true identity and enters her own company as an intern to uncover a massive fraud. But what starts as a secret mission soon turns into a battlefield of ego, deception, and betrayal where enemies wear friendly faces, and one wrong move could cost her everything.
Will Shailoo expose the truth before the truth destroys her?
